about: v5 cases for the evcheck command line, written on 2026-11-17 before evcheck was written; every label was fixed when the case was written. kind: correct (should pass), error (a changed or invented number or quote; should be flagged), meaning (wrong, but its numbers and quotes are in the sources; expected to pass), limit (a number worked out from the sources; flagged on purpose), skip (no number and no quote).
